finding.description: The shared selector used only PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment and omitted separately reported PaymentsForSoftware from CFO-based FCF.

required_shared_remediation: Use a reported aggregate cash-capex concept when available without adding its components again.
Otherwise sum only period-, unit-, currency-, form-, and accession-matched cash-capex components.
Exclude CapitalExpendituresIncurredButNotYetPaid from CFO-based cash FCF.
Require auditable component lineage and a passing capex-coverage control whenever raw FCF is emitted.
After the shared fix, freeze again and use a completely new issuer for final S17 acceptance.
